title: openEHR Common Information Model
description: OOJS representation of the openEHR RM common specification (RM Release 1.1.0). Covers the archetyped, generic, directory, change_control, and resource packages.

PATHABLE.description: Defines path-navigation capabilities used by nearly all classes in the openEHR RM via inheritance of LOCATABLE. PATHABLE objects can locate child objects using openEHR paths and know their parent in a compositional hierarchy. All functions (item_at_path, items_at_path, path_exists, path_unique, path_of_item) are behavioural and carry no stored attributes.

ARCHETYPED.description: Archetype identification metadata attached to archetype root points in data. Records the generating archetype_id, optional template_id, and the RM version used to create the object.

template_id.description: Optional globally unique template identifier active at this point in the structure.

rm_version.description: Version of the openEHR RM used to create this object, e.g. '1.1.0'.

LINK.description: A typed, directed logical relationship between two archetyped structures. Links may cross composition and EHR boundaries. The meaning describes the clinical relationship; type gives a domain-level category; target is the referenced object.

meaning.description: Clinical description of the relationship, e.g. 'in response to', 'follow-up to'.

type.description: Domain-level type of the link, e.g. 'problem', 'issue'.

target.description: The target object of the link relation.

FEEDER_AUDIT_DETAILS.description: Audit details for one system in a feeder chain: the system identifier, optional location, subject, provider, handling time, version identifier, and any custom meta-data.

system_id.description: Identifier of the system that handled the item.

location.description: Optional site or facility within the organisation that handled the item.

subject.description: Optional identifiers for the subject of the received item.

provider.description: Optional provider who created, committed, or forwarded the item.

time.description: Optional time of handling the item.

version_id.description: Optional version identifier used in the source system, e.g. 'interim', 'final'.

other_details.description: Optional custom meta-data, may be archetyped.

FEEDER_AUDIT.description: Audit trail describing the origin of data transformed into openEHR form from a feeder or legacy system. Records identifiers from the originating and feeder systems, optional original content, and mandatory originating-system audit details.

originating_system_item_ids.description: Identifiers for the item in the originating system, e.g. filler and placer ids.

feeder_system_item_ids.description: Identifiers for the item in the feeder system, where distinct from the originating system.

original_content.description: Optional inline or referenced original content corresponding to the openEHR content at this node.

originating_system_audit.description: Audit information from the originating system.

feeder_system_audit.description: Optional audit information from the feeder system, if distinct from the originating system.

LOCATABLE.description: Root of all information model classes that can be archetyped and path-addressed. Carries a runtime name, a design-time archetype_node_id, and optional uid, links, archetype_details, and feeder_audit.

name.description: Runtime name of this node, used to build runtime paths.

archetype_node_id.description: Design-time archetype node identifier, e.g. 'at0005'. At archetype root points this is the stringified archetype_id.

uid.description: Optional globally unique identifier; recommended for archetype root points.

links.description: Optional links to other archetyped structures.

archetype_details.description: Archetype identification metadata; present only at archetype root points.

feeder_audit.description: Optional audit trail from a feeder or legacy system.

PARTY_PROXY.description: Abstract proxy description of a party, with an optional reference to fuller demographic data in an external service. Subtypes are PARTY_SELF (the subject of the record) and PARTY_IDENTIFIED (any other party).

external_ref.description: Optional reference to demographic or identity management data for this party in an external system.

PARTY_SELF.description: Party proxy representing the subject of the record. Used wherever the record owner must be referenced. May or may not have external_ref set.

PARTY_IDENTIFIED.description: Proxy for an identified party other than the subject of the record. At least one of name, identifiers, or external_ref must be present. Used for health care providers and other participants.

identifiers.description: Optional list of formal identifiers, e.g. NHS number, provider number.

PARTY_RELATED.description: Proxy for a party whose relationship to the subject of the record is known and required, e.g. 'mother', 'donor'. The relationship is coded from the openEHR terminology group 'subject relationship'.

relationship.description: Relationship of this party to the subject of the record, coded from openEHR terminology group 'subject_relationship'.

PARTICIPATION.description: Model of a party's participation in an activity, capturing the performer, their function, optional mode of interaction, and optional time interval of participation.

performer.description: The party participating in the activity.

function.description: The function of the party in this participation. Should be coded where possible.

mode.description: Optional mode of interaction, e.g. 'present', 'by telephone', 'by email'. Coded from openEHR terminology group 'participation_mode'.

time.description: Optional time interval of the participation.

AUDIT_DETAILS.description: The set of attributes documenting the committal of an information item to a repository: the system, committer, time, type of change, and optional description.

system_id.description: Identifier of the logical EHR system where the change was committed.

committer.description: Identity of the user who committed the item.

change_type.description: Type of change, coded from openEHR terminology group 'audit_change_type', e.g. 249|creation|, 250|amendment|, 251|modification|, 523|deleted|.

description.description: Optional reason for committal, qualifying the change_type.

ATTESTATION.description: An explicit signing by a healthcare agent of particular record content, for purposes such as authorisation, witnessing, or acknowledgement. Extends AUDIT_DETAILS with attested_view, proof, items, reason, and is_pending.

attested_view.description: Optional visual representation of the content attested, e.g. a screen image.

proof.description: Optional openPGP digital signature or digest of the attested content.

items.description: Optional list of runtime paths to specific items being attested. If absent, the entire VERSION is attested.

reason.description: Reason for attestation, optionally coded from openEHR terminology group 'attestation_reason'.

is_pending.description: True if this attestation is outstanding (awaiting completion); False if completed.

REVISION_HISTORY_ITEM.description: One entry in a revision history, associating a version identifier with the list of audits (commits and attestations) that apply to that version.

audits.description: Audits for this revision; at least one commit audit, plus any subsequent attestations.

REVISION_HISTORY.description: Ordered list of REVISION_HISTORY_ITEMs representing the complete audit history of a versioned resource, in most-recent-last order.

items.description: The revision history items in most-recent-last order.

FOLDER.description: A named folder that may contain references to versioned objects and/or sub-folders. Used to organise EHR content into directory-like structures. The uid of the root FOLDER should be copied from the enclosing VERSION.uid.

items.description: Optional references to versioned objects logically contained in this folder.

details.description: Optional archetyped meta-data for this folder.

VERSIONED_FOLDER.description: A version-controlled hierarchy of FOLDERs, providing the effect of a versioned directory. Each version of the container holds a FOLDER tree.

VERSION.description: Abstract model of one version within a VERSIONED_OBJECT. Carries the contribution reference, optional digital signature, and commit audit. The uid, preceding_version_uid, data, and lifecycle_state are defined concretely in subtypes.

contribution.description: Reference to the CONTRIBUTION in which this version was added.

commit_audit.description: Audit trail for the committal of this version.

signature.description: Optional openPGP digital signature or digest of the canonical form of this version.

ORIGINAL_VERSION.description: A version containing locally created content. Stores its own uid and preceding_version_uid, lifecycle state, optional attestations, optional merge inputs, and the versioned data payload.

preceding_version_uid.description: Identifier of the version from which this one was derived. Absent for the first version.

other_input_version_uids.description: Optional identifiers of other versions merged into this one.

lifecycle_state.description: Lifecycle state of the content, coded from openEHR vocabulary 'version_lifecycle_state': 532|complete|, 553|incomplete|, 523|deleted|.

attestations.description: Optional attestations associated with this version.

IMPORTED_VERSION.description: A wrapper around an ORIGINAL_VERSION copied from another system. Provides its own contribution and commit_audit for the local import act, while preserving the original version's identity and content inside item.

VERSIONED_OBJECT.description: Version control abstraction for one complex object. Holds a unique uid (the virtual version tree id), a reference to the owning entity, and the creation time. All version access is via functions; the internal version collection is implementation-defined.

uid.description: Unique identifier of this version container; the same across all distributed copies.

owner_id.description: Reference to the owning object, e.g. the EHR.

time_created.description: Time of initial creation of this versioned object.

CONTRIBUTION.description: Documents a change-set (contribution) of one or more versions added to a change-controlled repository in a single logical commit. Carries a unique uid, the set of version references, and the commit audit.

versions.description: References to the versions added or modified in this contribution.

audit.description: Audit trail for the committal of this contribution.

TRANSLATION_DETAILS.description: Details of a natural language translation of an AUTHORED_RESOURCE, including the target language, translator identity, optional accreditation, and any other meta-data.

language.description: Language of the translation, coded from openEHR Code Set 'languages'.

author.description: Translator name and other demographic details, serialised as a string map.

accreditation.description: Optional accreditation of the translator, e.g. a national registration id.

other_details.description: Optional additional meta-data as a serialised string map.

RESOURCE_DESCRIPTION_ITEM.description: Language-specific descriptive meta-data for an AUTHORED_RESOURCE. One instance per language. Contains purpose, optional keywords, use, misuse, copyright, original resource URIs, and other language-sensitive details.

language.description: Language of this description item, coded from openEHR Code Set 'languages'.

keywords.description: Optional keywords for indexing and searching.

use.description: Optional description of appropriate use contexts.

misuse.description: Optional description of contexts in which the resource should not be used.

original_resource_uri.description: Optional URIs of original clinical documents formalised by this resource, serialised as a string map keyed by meaning.

other_details.description: Optional additional language-sensitive meta-data, serialised as a string map.

RESOURCE_DESCRIPTION.description: Descriptive meta-data of an AUTHORED_RESOURCE: original author, optional other contributors, lifecycle state, optional package URI, optional other details, and language-specific description items keyed by language code.

original_author.description: Original author details serialised as a string map (name, organisation, email, date).

lifecycle_state.description: Lifecycle state of the resource, e.g. 'initial', 'submitted', 'approved', 'superseded', 'obsolete'.

resource_package_uri.description: Optional URI of the package to which this resource belongs.

other_details.description: Optional additional non-language-sensitive meta-data, serialised as a string map.

details.description: Language-specific description items; one per available language.

AUTHORED_RESOURCE.description: Abstract root of online resources created by a human author. Carries the original authoring language, optional translation details, optional descriptive meta-data, and optional revision history (required when is_controlled is true).

original_language.description: Language in which this resource was originally authored, coded from openEHR Code Set 'languages'.

is_controlled.description: True if this resource is under change control, in which case revision_history must be present.

description.description: Optional descriptive meta-data and lifecycle information.

revision_history.description: Revision history; required when is_controlled is true.

translations.description: Optional translation details for each language other than the original; one entry per translated language.
